name: The Handgunners' Barracks
summary: Eight straw pallets for the castle's handgunners, their hand-cannon racked on the north wall, painted pavises propped on the south wall, and a dice table.
description: The handgunners are the new men of the garrison, paid more than the halberdiers and resented for it. They sleep eight to a room on straw pallets against the side walls, their hand-cannon racked on the north wall where the sergeant can count them, and their pavises, the tall painted shields they fight behind, propped along the south wall ready to be snatched up. Off duty they play dice at the table by the north archway, with a small stake of coin between the cups. Their footlockers hold everything they own, which is not much, and everything they have taken from the dead, which is sometimes a great deal.
build: Shell: the kit's OuterBailey shell, 12.0 × 12.0 × 0.30 m slab, 0.50 m dressed-sandstone walls 3.60 m clear, a 0.45 m brick trim course, an archway 2.60 × 2.59 m centred on every wall.

Pallets: eight, two per quadrant, oak frames 0.90 × 2.00 × 0.20 m at |x| 3.90 and 5.00, |y| 2.60 … 4.60, long axis north–south; a straw tick 0.12 m on each and a green wool blanket over the half nearer the crossing.
Handgun rack (NW): two oak rails 2.20 m on the north wall at 0.59 and 1.85 m above ground, centred x −3.30; four hand-cannon, oak stocks 0.95 m standing on the floor, iron barrels 0.85 m.
Footlockers: iron-bound oak 0.80 × 0.50 × 0.50 m at (−5.00, 5.05) and (−5.00, −5.05), at the heads of the outer west pallets.
Dice table (NE): oak 1.00 × 0.70 m, top 0.75 m at (2.50, 3.60), between the pallets and the crossing; two oak stools r 0.18 m at y 2.95 and 4.25.
On the table: two pewter cups, two dice, a stake of gilt coin.
Pavises (SE): three oak shields 0.60 × 0.08 × 1.30 m stood against the south wall at x 2.40 / 3.10 / 3.80, madder painted faces 0.50 × 1.10 m.
The crossing: bare floor between all four archways.
sockets: Archway ×4, centred on each wall: 2.60 × 2.59 m (OuterBailey), all open
Dice table: a loot anchor at 1.05 m

materials.name: Oak
materials.notes: Pallet frames, rack, table, stools, pavises.

gameplay: Handgunners wake here: a noise in the barracks turns eight sleepers into eight guards.
The racked hand-cannon are the garrison's firepower; taking them disarms the handgunners.
Three loot anchors: the stake on the table and two footlockers.
